title: Watchlight Short
note: Script: SmishFilter docs/video/watchlight-howto-script.md. Footage: build 1.0 (14) in the simulator, made-up texts only.

scenes.narration: Worried about scam texts on a parent's iPhone? Here's a second opinion that runs on the phone itself.
Copy the text, open Watchlight, and tap Paste.
It shows each warning sign, how much it counts, and what to do.
No warning signs found isn't a guarantee, and it says so.
Ask someone I trust sends it to a person they choose, like you. Or report it to seven seven two six.
Turn on the text filter, and texts from unknown numbers are checked as they arrive.
Every warning is free. The full how-to is on our channel.
